Ring+beam crane: A1/A2 move ring+beam y-/+6, carry on-beam blocks, chain-push blocks hit; any block y outside [2,58] cancels the move.
A4/A3 beam w+/-6 in [1,43]: a next/collected block at the tip (x==beam.x+w-5) drags all on-beam blocks; otherwise extend pushes next/collected blocks in the swept columns (chain push).
A blocked group (x>48 or inside the ring) stays where it is and the beam changes alone. Clicks, A5 and A7 do nothing.
Missed mechanic (step 128): a hooked 'next' block becomes collected when every OTHER on-beam block is already collected, not only when it is alone; then the rightmost todo becomes next. A collected block left off the beam, with nothing hooked, reverts to next.
Stateless, 146 lines. Changing the collect rule back to alone-on-beam fails only step 128. Unconfirmed: ring y bounds, and which collected block reverts when several are off the beam.
